limits: Four-region minima within10micrometers are a CAD geometry support convention, not a measured noise/shoe/clinical tolerance.
At least3 actual-plane vertices with noncollinear XZ are required separately; near-contact ROI points are not silently counted as exact contact.
All curved sole vertices need not be coplanar; no body-weight support, finite-area pressure or functional/anatomical necessity claim.
Finite search proves a passing witness exists; FAIL is best observed strict failure, not certified global unreachability/clinical infeasibility.
Assembly roll is a geometric adapter convention, not measured/clinically qualified hardware alignment; local SEA internal axes/properties remain unchanged.
